description: Independently produced, publicly available mail captures used as an external validation layer. They were not generated by SecureMailScope or its lab. Files are NOT redistributed in this repository: tests/external_captures/fetch.py downloads them and verifies the pinned SHA-256.
license: Original content on the Wireshark wiki is available under the GNU General Public License (https://wiki.wireshark.org/License). The files are downloaded at test time and not committed here.

not_obtainable.imap.cap, sample-imf.pcap.gz: Download returned a bot-protection challenge page instead of the file; not circumvented.

expected_observations_note: Expected values are SecureMailScope's observations recorded on first analysis. The negotiated TLS version, the negotiated cipher suite and the presence of RC4/DES suites in the ClientHello were cross-checked with an independent parser (dpkt.ssl), see test_external_captures.py. Certificate and rule observations are a regression baseline, not independent ground truth.

captures.contributor_note: Contributed by Peter Wu (Wireshark developer; GitHub 'Lekensteyn'); the same file is in github.com/Lekensteyn/wireshark-notes under tls/ (that repository declares no licence, so the Wireshark wiki copy is used). IMAP STARTTLS against a Dovecot server. The pcapng file carries TLS keys in capture comments; SecureMailScope never decrypts and ignores them.
captures.limitations: Single session; lab-style server with Dovecot's default self-signed certificate.
